people.name: Titus
people.line: Gentile convert and companion of Paul

translations.web: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?
translations.bsb: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent our brother with him. Did Titus exploit you in any way? Did we not walk in the same Spirit and follow in the same footsteps?
translations.kjv: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did ➔ Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
